director.name: 亚里沙·科瓦连科 Alisa Kovalenko

playdate: 2025-03(哥本哈根国际纪录片电影节)
introduction: The battle rages on, but everything seems so calm and fragile, until a missile shatters everything. A first-hand look into the reality of the Ukrainian front line, by a director and a mother, who became a soldier. Frontline reveals a very different and unseen side of war through a camera that is both a soldier’s and a documentary filmmaker’s eye.
